english.title: Conspire to steal from employer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to steal **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE..), from your employer

(E)_[to the value of **(..SPECIFY THE VALUE..)]_
(F)_[of a value unknown]_

belonging to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conspired to dishonestly appropriate property belonging his / her employer
with the intention to permanently deprive the other of it

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required where the offence involves theft of spouse's property.
